assignmentTitle: 作業二：技能、專業能力與成就
assignments: 作業一：個人背景與動機
作業二：技能、專業能力與成就
作業三：情境與問題解決能力
作業四：工作態度與職場軟實力
作業五：企業了解、未來展望與提問
questions: What skills do you have that are relevant to this position?
What is your proudest accomplishment during your college years?
What is your greatest strength, and what is one area you would like to improve?

job.description: 主要負責分析與改善企業的生產流程與工作方式，以提升效率、降低成本、減少浪費並維持產品品質。服務對象包含管理階層、生產及品質部門與現場作業人員。日常工作通常包括觀察現場流程、分析生產數據、進行時間研究、找出問題原因，並與不同部門合作提出改善方案及追蹤改善成果。
job.competencies: 需具備分析、問題解決、組織規劃、溝通協調及數據處理能力，能透過分析生產流程與數據找出問題，並提出改善方案，並提出改善方案，同時也需要具備品質管理與持續改善的能力，與不同部門合作以提升工作效率，降低成本並維持品質。

scaffold.role_connection: 這題要對應工業工程師常做的流程分析、數據判讀和改善提案。
experience_prompts: 你有沒有做過整理數據、找出問題原因的經驗？
哪一次你曾經觀察流程，發現哪裡太慢或太亂？
sentence_starters: One relevant skill I have is…

draft1: My strongest skills for this job are process analysis and layout planning. During my factory internship, I checked the time needed for each step on the assembly line and found problems where parts piled up. As an Industrial Engineer, I can use these skills to reduce unnecessary movements, make work easier, and improve the efficiency of the production line.

feedback.question: What is your greatest strength, and what is one area you would like to improve?

corrections.original: During my internship, I watched how people worked and talked with workers to understand the problems they faced everyday.
corrections.corrected: During my internship, I watched how people worked and talked with workers to understand the problems they faced every day.
corrections.explanation: every day 是副詞片語，表示「每天」；everyday 是形容詞，不能直接用在這裡。

corrections.original: One thing I want to improve is using numbers to support my ideas.
corrections.corrected: One area I want to improve is using numbers to support my ideas.
corrections.explanation: one area I want to improve 是更自然的固定表達，適合面試中談待改善的部分。

feedback.polished: My greatest strength is observing work and communicating clearly. During my internship, I watched how people worked and talked with workers to understand the problems they faced every day. One area I want to improve is using numbers to support my ideas. I am now learning data analysis tools so I can make better suggestions and show how much time can be saved.

I am now learning data analysis tools to make better suggestions and show how much time can be saved.

shadow.question: What skills do you have that are relevant to this position?
shadow.transcript: My strongest skills for this job are process analysis and layout planning. During my factory internship, I checked the time needed for each step on the assembly line and found problems where parts were piling up. As an industrial engineer, I can use these skills to reduce unnecessary movement, make work easier and improve production line efficiency. I believe these skills match this position very well.

roleplay.q: What skills do you have that are relevant to this position?
roleplay.a: I think my strongest skills are process analysis and problem solving. During my factory internship, I observed the production line and checked how long each step took. I also found some problems that slow down the work. I believe I can use these skills to improve work process, reduce unnecessary movements, and make production more efficient.

roleplay.q: What is your proudest accomplishment during your college years?
roleplay.a: My proudest achievement was the facilities planning project. My team worked on improving the layout of a factory workstation. I helped measure work time, find problems, and suggest a better layout. In the end, we reduced working distances and made the work process smoother. I was happy because I could use what I learned in class to solve real problems.

roleplay.q: What do you think is your greatest strength, and what is one area you would like to improve?
roleplay.a: My greatest strength is that I'm good at observing and communicating with others. During my internship, I talked with workers to understand the problems they faced in their daily work. However, I want to get better at using data to support my ideas. So I'm learning data analysis tools to make better decisions and find ways to save time.

I think you should hire me because I have knowledge of industrial engineering and real factoring experience. During my internship, I learned how to find problems on the production line and work with others to solve them. I am willing to learn, work hard, and cooperate with the team. I hope I can help improve production efficiency and product quality.

roleplay.q: During your internship, you mentioned that you identified bottlenecks on the production line; what was one challenge you faced while finding those problems?
roleplay.a: One challenge was finding a real reason for delays on the production line. At first, it was not easy to know why some parts of the process took longer than others. So, I carefully observed the workers, checked the time for each step, and talked with them about their work. This helped me better understand the problems and think about possible improvements.

content_logic: 「I observed... checked how long each step took」先方法後發現，邏輯清楚。
「I was happy because...」偏感受，若補一句成果影響會更完整。
language_accuracy: 「real factoring experience」應為「real factory experience」，屬明顯用詞誤差。
「improve work process」可改成「improve the work process」，表達更完整。
interview_strategy: 「I think you should hire me because...」直接回答題目，態度自然。
可把「willing to learn」接到職務需求，強化你能快速上手的印象。
language_complexity: 「process analysis and problem solving」用詞明確，已能對應工業工程職務。
可再加入一個具體方法，如「time study」或「root cause analysis」，讓能力更立體。

strengths: 能把實習經驗連到流程改善，和工業工程職務高度相關。
有主動觀察、與現場人員溝通的例子，能展現實務合作能力。
overall_suggestions: 每題先講結論，再補一個具體例子，讓重點更快被聽懂。
描述成果時加上影響，例如節省時間、減少距離或提升效率。
準備一兩個固定專業詞，如 bottleneck、time study、root cause，增加專業感。

reflection.q: 這次練習中，你最滿意或最有進步的地方是什麼？請舉一個具體例子。
reflection.a: 我覺得進步最多的部分是第二題錄音講大學最自豪成就的部分，沒有像以前回答得很空泛，而是嘗試直接破題並清楚講出自己負責的部分，讓整個回答有條理的帶出自己做了什麼和最後的成果。

reflection.q: 寫作、跟讀、角色扮演中，哪一部分最有挑戰？你遇到什麼困難，又如何處理？
reflection.a: 我覺得角色扮演錄音時的第三題（將優缺點）最有挑戰，一開始講到要改進的地方時，會擔心不小心講到致命的缺點或顯得比較沒自信，而我的處理方式是把缺點轉成正在努力的方向，展現積極改善的態度。

reflection.q: 看完 AI 回饋後，你認為自己的一項優勢與一項最需要改進的地方是什麼？
reflection.a: 看過AI回饋後，我的優勢是在回答時能用到一些專業詞彙，比如在第一題和第四題都有提到，最需要改進的是描述成果時少了具體的影響，像在第二題可以補上提升產線效率、減少幾%的走動。

reflection.q: 如果重新進行一次面試，你會如何調整準備方式或回答內容？
reflection.a: 如果重來一次，在回答第四題為什麼要錄用我時，我會調整成先給一句核心結論，再補充一個現場故事的結構。

reflection.q: 請訂下一個具體行動：要做什麼、何時完成、如何確認自己有進步？
reflection.a: 我打算在下禮拜一之前在四題的回答各挑出一個代表性的改善影響或成果例子確保口說順暢，具體做法是打開手機錄音，嘗試每題不看稿演練兩次，最後聽回放如果確認自己能順暢講完，就表示自己進步了。

grade.comment: 總體來說表現非常不錯！無論是學習態度或課堂表現都值得肯定，請繼續保持，相信英文能力一定會持續進步！
grade.feedback: 整體表現良好，文法與發音方面皆沒有太大問題。若能持續累積單字量並加強口語表達，相信英文能力會更上一層樓！

rubric.name: AI 英語面試練習評分規準
rubric.description: 依寫作初稿、跟讀、模擬面試與心得，以五個向度評量，總分 100 分。
notes: 先看學生自己做的部分：寫作看初稿，口說看錄音。
有認真作答就從「不錯」開始考慮，再往上或往下調整。
只有沒交，或內容完全無法判斷時，才給 0 分。

dimensions.name: 寫作初稿：回答內容
dimensions.description: 看四題初稿：有沒有回答到題目、有沒有寫出自己的經驗，以及和應徵的職位有沒有關聯。

levels.label: 很好
levels.anchor: 四題都有切題，而且有用自己的具體經驗連到職位。

levels.label: 不錯
levels.anchor: 大致切題，也有寫到自己的經驗，少數題目比較籠統。

levels.label: 還可以
levels.anchor: 有回答，但內容偏短、偏一般，或夾雜較多中文。

levels.label: 待加強
levels.anchor: 多題偏題、過短，或大部分用中文寫。

levels.label: 未作答
levels.anchor: 沒有初稿，或內容無法判斷。

dimensions.name: 跟讀：聽得清楚
dimensions.description: 聽四題跟讀錄音，判斷聽的人能不能輕鬆聽懂。

levels.label: 很好
levels.anchor: 清楚、順暢，幾乎不用費力就聽得懂。

levels.label: 不錯
levels.anchor: 大致清楚，偶爾卡住或念錯，但不影響理解。

levels.label: 還可以
levels.anchor: 停頓較多或逐字念，要用心聽才聽得懂。

levels.label: 待加強
levels.anchor: 常中斷或多處聽不清楚。

levels.label: 未作答
levels.anchor: 沒有可用的錄音。

dimensions.name: 模擬面試：四個核心題
dimensions.description: 聽角色扮演前四題，判斷是否回答到面試官的問題。不要求和寫作草稿一致。

levels.label: 很好
levels.anchor: 四題都答到重點，有自己的例子，聽起來像在對話，不像在背稿。

levels.label: 不錯
levels.anchor: 多數題目答到重點，少數回答較短或較籠統。

levels.label: 還可以
levels.anchor: 能回答，但內容偏短，或明顯是在念準備好的稿。

levels.label: 待加強
levels.anchor: 多題沒答到問題，或回答很零散。

levels.label: 未作答
levels.anchor: 沒有完成，或錄音無法判斷。

dimensions.name: 模擬面試：臨場追問
dimensions.description: 聽最後一題追問，判斷學生是否針對被問到的事情回答。

levels.label: 很好
levels.anchor: 直接回答被問的事，並補充了細節或例子。

levels.label: 不錯
levels.anchor: 有回答到問題，但細節不多。

levels.label: 還可以
levels.anchor: 方向大致對，但回答不完整。

levels.label: 待加強
levels.anchor: 沒有回答到問題，或只重複前面的答案。

levels.label: 未作答
levels.anchor: 沒有回答，或錄音無法判斷。

dimensions.name: 心得
dimensions.description: 判斷有沒有講到這次練習的具體情況，以及下一步打算怎麼做。

levels.label: 很好
levels.anchor: 有提到這次作業的具體地方（某一題、某段錄音），下一步也具體可行。

levels.label: 不錯
levels.anchor: 有提到具體的地方，或下一步具體，兩者至少做到一項。

levels.label: 還可以
levels.anchor: 五題都有寫，但多是「要多練習」「要加強」這類一般說法。

levels.label: 待加強
levels.anchor: 有幾題空著，或內容非常簡短。

levels.label: 未作答
levels.anchor: 沒有送出心得。
